direction.side_direction: Unit tangent sum, oriented proximal-to-center; parallel/curved uses robust local centerline, never theoretical intersection

cap.selection: Enumerate16 fixed per-frame joint/ellipse solves, rank feasible current-RGB fits by median residual,RMS,join retreat,r. Tip length fixed to supported cluster extent, no theoretical intersection/no tip retreat.

bisector_tip.mask: Protect ALL union fiber and ALL blue B, stone immutable; currentRGB evidence-band additions inside fitted sides/cap only; root4CC; no delete/fill gap/extrapolate; unknown returns exact union
bisector_tip.temporal: Raw T1 prior unchanged. Diagnostics tip displacement between consecutive RGB-confirmed frames only, no historical filling.
